Notes on arithmetic and generics

This note contains prose that looks like markup but is not. A normalizer that treats every asterisk as emphasis will invent numbers that were never written, and a normalizer that treats every angle bracket as a tag will delete sentences. Preserving the version history lets you recover the source text as it was cited.

The area is 2*3*4 = 24 for the default configuration. When the exponent form 2**3**2 = 512 appears in prose it must survive untouched. A shell glob such as *.txt is also prose here, not a formatting instruction.

Generics

A method may return List<String> or Map<String, IRI> depending on the overload. Neither of those is an HTML tag, and neither may be removed. Saying that you do not know beats giving a fast wrong answer.

Conditional requests plus a body hash remove most refetching. Infrastructure built as a centrally funded service disappears when the budget does.
